test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Some parts of a few sentences have been jumbled up, and labelled A, B, C and D.

Select the option that gives the correct sequence in which these parts can be rearranged to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

The Ramayana is one of the largest ancient

A. 24,000 verses divided into seven Khanda (parts)

B. the first and the seventh being later additions.

C. epics in world literature. It consists of nearly

D. It belongs to the genre of Itihasa, narratives of past events, interspersed with teachings on the goals of human life.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **correct sequence** to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence is **CABD.**
 
• **C. **"The Ramayana is one of the largest ancient epics in world literature." **This part sets up the topic **of the sentence, which is the Ramayana.
 
• **A.** "It consists of nearly 24,000 verses divided into seven Khanda (parts)" **This provides specific details **about the structure of the Ramayana, following logically from the introduction of the Ramayana as the topic.
 
• **B.** "the first and the seventh being later additions." **This provides additional detail** about the structure of the Ramayana, specifically the first and seventh parts.
 
• **D. **"It belongs to the genre of Itihasa, narratives of past events, interspersed with teachings on the goals of human life." This is a general statement about the Ramayana's genre and thematic content, which serves as a suitable conclusion to the sentence.

Therefore, the **correct and meaningful sentence** is: *"The Ramayana is one of the largest ancient epics in world literature. It consists of nearly 24,000 verses divided into seven Khanda (parts), the first and the seventh being later additions. It belongs to the genre of Itihasa, narratives of past events, interspersed with teachings on the goals of human life."*
